en.shortDescription: Secret scanner for Git repositories and source files
en.longDescription:
Gitleaks detects hardcoded secrets such as API keys, tokens, and passwords in repos and directories.

Mount sources under /scan (browse on port 8080) and run docker compose exec --entrypoint gitleaks gitleaks detect --source=/scan.

de.longDescription:
Gitleaks erkennt hartkodierte Geheimnisse wie API-Keys, Tokens und Passwörter in Repositories und Verzeichnissen.

Binde die Quellen unter /scan ein (Durchsuchen auf Port 8080) und führe docker compose exec --entrypoint gitleaks gitleaks detect --source=/scan aus.

fr.shortDescription: Scanner de secrets pour les dépôts Git et fichiers sources
fr.longDescription:
Gitleaks détecte les secrets codés en dur comme les clés API, jetons et mots de passe dans les dépôts et répertoires.

Montez les sources sous /scan (parcours sur le port 8080) et exécutez docker compose exec --entrypoint gitleaks gitleaks detect --source=/scan.

pt.shortDescription: Scanner de segredos para repositórios Git e arquivos-fonte
pt.longDescription:
Gitleaks detecta segredos codificados como chaves de API, tokens e senhas em repositórios e diretórios.

Monte as fontes em /scan (navegação na porta 8080) e execute docker compose exec --entrypoint gitleaks gitleaks detect --source=/scan.
